title: GitHub Updates actions/checkout to Block Common Pwn Request Attack Patterns
summary: GitHub is moving to strengthen software supply chain security by updating "actions/checkout" to block pwn request attacks that exploit the risky use of the "pull_request_target workflow" trigger to run malicious code with the workflow's full privileges.
